item.title: Good Morning Family - 22 September 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Tuesday, the 22 September.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 16 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is E.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter E?
